newsitem.title: RUSSIA: WEATHER - Conditions at CIS airports - October 29.
newsitem.headline: WEATHER - Conditions at CIS airports - October 29.

text.p: Strong winds may force the western Russian airport of Kaliningrad to close on October 30, the State Weather Service said on Tuesday.
It said that the probability of closure was 80 percent.
Wet snow may close Magadan, Khabarovsk and the Sakhalin's airports in Russia's Far East on October 30, it said.
Flights may be postponed at airports on the Kamchatka Peninsula the same day due to winds and snow, the service said.
